args.query: FastAPI Stripe webhook endpoint verifying the Stripe-Signature header

results.title: FastAPI + Stripe webhook signature verification
results.summary: Verify Stripe webhook signatures in FastAPI from the raw request body and dispatch on event type. Tested offline with locally signed payloads.

results.title: Express 5 + Stripe webhook signature verification
results.summary: Verify Stripe webhook signatures in Express 5 using the raw body, then dispatch on event type. Tested offline with generated test headers.

results.title: Next.js App Router + Stripe webhook handler
results.summary: A Next.js route handler that verifies Stripe webhook signatures from the raw body and handles checkout.session.completed.

results.title: Stripe Node SDK Checkout Sessions with a mocked HTTP client
results.summary: Create Stripe Checkout Sessions with line items, metadata and idempotency keys, tested offline by plugging a fake fetch into Stripe.createFetchHttpClient.

results.title: FastAPI endpoint with Pydantic v2 discriminated unions and Annotated validators
results.summary: Accept a tagged union of payment methods with Field(discriminator), add Annotated validators, and test the exact 422 error shapes offline with TestClient.

results.title: FastAPI WebSockets with token auth and broadcast, tested with TestClient
results.summary: FastAPI WebSocket endpoint that authenticates via query token, rejects with a close code and broadcasts to connected clients; tested with TestClient.websocket_connect.

results.title: FastAPI Jinja2 full pages vs HTMX partials via HX-Request
results.summary: Serve a full HTML page to normal browsers and a bare HTML fragment to HTMX requests, chosen by the HX-Request header, with Vary set for caches. Tested offline with the sync TestClient.

results.title: FastAPI with async SQLAlchemy 2 on aiosqlite, tested offline with per-test in-memory DBs
results.summary: A FastAPI app using AsyncSession and async_sessionmaker on aiosqlite, tested with httpx.AsyncClient over ASGITransport, overriding the session dependency with a fresh in-memory database for each test.

results.title: FastAPI dependency_overrides tested offline with httpx ASGITransport
results.summary: Override FastAPI dependencies (including nested ones) and drive the app in-process with httpx.ASGITransport, no network and no running server.

results.title: FastAPI metrics with prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator tested offline
results.summary: Instrument a FastAPI app with the default prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator metrics, scrape /metrics through httpx.ASGITransport, and cover the route-template labels, untemplated grouping, self-scraping and shared-registry gotchas.
